title: Choose the visual world for BukSU Market
question: The roll assigned Jeepney Signboard. Keep it, take the alternate, or re-roll. Your navy + green palette is fixed in every option.

options.label: Jeepney Signboard
options.lineage: Hand-painted jeepney route placards and sign-painter lettering around Malaybalay
options.thesis: Every listing is a route placard: the size and the school are the destination, painted big.
options.viewport: A reversed navy route strip spells your active search (UNIFORMS · SIZE M · NURSING) over a dense, photo-first grid of boards with price and size painted as placard numerals.
options.risk: Tips into jeepney-art cosplay if the lettering goes decorative; the task has to stay the loudest thing.

raised.raise: Price and size are the fixed-position numerals of every board, in one engineered numeral face, and the only loud type.
States are marks, not tints: SOLD is a struck bar across the board, and corners are square everywhere.
Rank is carried by weight, case and reversal before size; one reversed navy plate per screen.
Green is reserved for the one act on each screen (Post Item, Message Seller), never decoration.

options.label: Ukay-ukay Size Tag
options.lineage: Pre-loved clothing racks where every piece hangs with a marker-written size and price tag
options.thesis: Every item wears a punched tag with its size and price, the way students already shop pre-loved.
options.viewport: Size tabs run across the top as the first filter; the photo grid below shows each item with its tag hanging off the corner carrying price and size.
options.risk: Familiar: the tag is the nearest-to-hand retail idea, and most runs in this category land somewhere close to it.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: 1970s pocket airline timetables on a light table
options.thesis: Listings as timetable rows set at one type size, ranked by weight and case.
options.viewport: A raked rack of listing rows, travel lateral along the rake.
options.case: Fuses on density but students don't know airline timetables, and a rake hurts phone scanning.
options.risk: Reads as a design exercise, not a campus market.
options.kept: Rank by weight, case and reversal; one reversed plate per screen.

options.label: Centre-rail Reference Page
options.thesis: Two text columns around a rail of keys, all rules drawn at one device pixel.
options.viewport: A small dense text block in a wide margin.
options.case: A reading form for a photo-first buying task; students don't identify with it.
options.risk: Hides the photos that sell the item.
options.kept: States as printed marks and no corner radius.

options.label: Nixie Counter
options.lineage: Lab counters with glowing digit tubes
options.thesis: Every quantity arrives as a glowing numeral.
options.viewport: Banks of price digits over a dark panel.
options.case: Breaks the pinned light palette and has nothing to do with campus life.
options.kept: Quantities are the interface: price and size as fixed-position numerals.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.thesis: One gold cord is both accent and control.
options.viewport: A flat plane gathered by one pull.
options.case: Beautiful but foreign to students and to buying uniforms.
options.kept: The accent is the control: green only on the one act per screen.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Carousell / Facebook Marketplace-style clean card grid, executed with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Search bar, category chips and a rounded photo-card grid, exactly as students expect.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other marketplace by design.
